Thanks Grace — excited to get this over the line. Quick answers to the questions you listed on the call:

- Source exports: We'll provide nightly Parquet exports from our search index (s3://acme-search/dumps/).
- Doc id stability: doc_id is stable across the catalog and will be the primary key.
- Language mix: ~85% en, 10% es, 5% other.

I've attached the data contract we've been using internally (acme_data_contract_v1.xlsx). Elena will own schema validation on our side.

Next step for us: confirm a backfill window that avoids our monthly rebuild (the first Monday of the month). We prefer a Tue/Wed evening window if possible.

-james

--
James Smith
Senior Product Manager, Search
Acme Search Platform

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Index handoff: data contract, backfill timeline, and rerank eval lanes

Thanks James — that's perfect context. Following up with a concrete ops plan so we can align owners and minimize customer risk. Draft below; please push back where needed.

Plan summary (high level)
- Export ingestion: Redwood will pull nightly Parquet from s3 + validate schema against attached contract.
- Backfill approach: incremental seed (1 week of highest-traffic docs) -> full backfill during agreed 36h maintenance window.
- Rerank evals: run two lanes in preview: A) current Acme model + Redwood embeddings; B) Redwood-rerank model tuned on Acme labels. We'll produce nDCG/precision@10 and failure-mode examples.

Owners and SLAs
- Acme: schema signoff (Elena), s3 path & temp credentials (James), maintenance window signoff (ops).
- Redwood: ingestion pipeline (Karthik), backfill orchestration + monitoring (Monica), rerank eval harness & reports (Marissa).

Questions for Acme (quick)
1) Can you confirm preferred maintenance window options (Tue 00:00–06:00 PT or Wed 22:00–10:00 PT)?
2) Are there any row-level filters we should apply (PII, soft deletes, embargoed docs)?
3) Expected index size (number of documents) for full backfill?

I attached a draft backfill runbook (index-backfill-plan-20250803.pdf) and the data contract. If that all looks good I can schedule a 30-min ops sync for Tue morning to lock the window.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>; James Smith <j.smith@acme.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Index handoff: data contract, backfill timeline, and rerank eval lanes

Hi all — schema and privacy notes below. Apologies for the long message, wanted to be explicit so we can avoid surprises during the backfill.

Schema notes
- doc_id: 64-bit integer, stable.
- title, body_html, body_text: strings. Prefer body_text for embeddings.
- lang: two-letter ISO. We can provide language confidence if useful.

Privacy / filters
- Exclude rows with flag soft_deleted=true.
- Mask user_handle and email fields (we will not provide these to Redwood).
- Embeddings training: Acme will not permit any outbound model updates that persist Acme data. Redwood should treat the dataset as query-only; any caches should be per-customer and revocable.

Index size
- Roughly 38M documents; nightly delta ~25k. Full compressed export size ~1.2TB.

Maintenance window
- Tue 00:00–06:00 PT preferred. Wed window conflicts with our analytics pipeline.

I'll upload a validated sample (10k rows) to the same s3 path by EOD today.

- Elena

--
Elena Ruiz
ML Engineering Manager, Acme Search Platform

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>, James Smith <j.smith@acme.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Index handoff: data contract, backfill timeline, and rerank eval lanes

Great notes, Elena — thank you. Quick operational clarifications from Redwood infra point of view:

- Backfill strategy we recommend: staged shards by creation_time descending (start with most recent high-traffic buckets) for a faster partial recovery. Full pass expected ~30 hours under our Dedicated capacity profile.
- Temp credentials: we'll need an IAM role with s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket scoped to the export prefix; please provide role ARN or short-lived keys.
- Memory footprint: for the full backfill we recommend using our 8xquant batch profile (docs attached in runbook) to keep costs predictable.

Action items
- Acme: provide IAM role ARN or short-lived credentials (James) — due Thu 6 Aug EOD PT.
- Acme: upload 10k sample + schema validation report (Elena) — due Wed 6 Aug EOD PT.
- Redwood: schedule ops-level run (Monica) and create rerank eval notebook (Marissa) — due Fri 8 Aug PT.

I'll schedule a 30-min ops sync for Tue 00:30 PT (during the proposed window) unless you prefer earlier.

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
